name: Weft
description: Search the web through Weft without separate provider API keys.

webSearch.apiKey.label: Weft API key
webSearch.apiKey.help: Weft buyer key. Fallback: WEFT_API_KEY in the Gateway environment.

webSearch.provider.label: Upstream provider
webSearch.provider.help: Use auto for the lowest-price compatible operation, or pin one provider.

webSearch.maxCostUsd.label: Maximum cost per search
webSearch.maxCostUsd.help: Hard USD ceiling for one paid search. Default: 0.01.

webSearch.baseUrl.label: Weft API base URL
webSearch.baseUrl.help: Optional Weft API URL. Public URLs must use HTTPS.
